title: チューリップ賞の後に・先制勝利！

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh yeahhh! I beat her!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka beat Daiwa Scarlet in their first G1 preliminary race.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Now I can feel good about jumpin' into the Classics. What'd ya think, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I know, right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But I did panic a bit. Scarlet got a lot stronger than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What's this? Did Vodka just praise somebody else? How unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Scarlet. Looks like you've been puttin' in a lot of effort. But you've still got a ways to go.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph! I'll let you be the flower, but just for today! After all, this is only a preliminary race!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: The next race is the real one! I'll show you a real turnaround at the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and try. I'll beat you again, no problem!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka gives a cool laugh and struts off like a winner.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Um… Is Vodka running a little differently?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Her style is still a little rough around the edges, but it seems more intimidating now…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: How has she been training?
choice_data_list: I think it's the result of how many real races she's been running in.
I think it's the result of how many real races she's been running in.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since the start of her career, Vodka has been going after G1 races without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems the results of her stretching her limits are starting to show in how she runs.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Real races, huh? I see…

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: When she mentioned the G1 last year, I thought she was being stupid again, but I guess there was some method to her madness.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well, only some!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: …All right, then. I'll just have to see how far she's come. The next race is for real.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Daiwa Scarlet's words aren't just a simple promise, but a full-blown declaration of war.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Heh. I guess she's not just a little Goody Two-shoes after all. This is gettin' interesting.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, about my next race… I'm doin' the Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaddya mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain that the Triple Crown tour and Tiara tour cover different races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho starts the Tiara, so racers usually follow it up with the Japanese Oaks and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby, on the other hand, is part of the Triple Crown. Vodka will have to give up on it if she chooses the Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So if I run in the Oka Sho, I can't run in the Derby?!
choice_data_list: It's not impossible, but it's not common.
It's not impossible, but it's not common.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Both the Triple Crown and the Tiara can only be attempted once. If Vodka switches around, she loses her shot at either title.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Then what am I supposed to do?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If I wanna run with Scarlet in the Classics now that she's stronger, that means I have to give up on the Derby?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've got it. How about this?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What if I run in all six races and win the Triple Crown and Tiara?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aughhh, fine! Then what now?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a big decision. Do the Tiara tour and run against her rival or do the Classic Triple Crown and run in the Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no correct choice, but Vodka and I need to make the decision together.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I think I've got an idea. Wanna hear it?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I don't think I can give up either. Before, I would've given Scarlet up without a thought…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But she's runnin' differently now. She's not just talk anymore. I feel real potential there.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This feelin' of wantin' to run in a real G1 race with her isn't gonna go away. So…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: How about going from the Oka Sho to the Japanese Derby? That's what I feel like I need to do.
choice_data_list: And you're okay giving up on both the Triple Crown and Tiara?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I-I didn't say I wanna give up! But…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is the only way I can think of to go after everythin' I want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's determination in her voice. It's still too early to make a decision at this stage, but…
choice_data_list: Let's go to the Oka Sho next.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You'll really let me?!
choice_data_list: For now, but we'll have to see how things go.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So we'll decide the next steps after the Oka Sho, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: All right. Let's do that. I know it's not something to be taken lightly.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Anyhow, I can't just quit while I'm ahead. First, I'm gonna face Scarlet in the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide to wait on choosing the path forward for now. It all depends on the results of the Oka Sho, as well as her determination afterward.
